title: Moss and the Shiny Stone
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ou as u, ear as er, or as er.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ou as u, ear as er, or as er.

pages.text: Moss trots along the stream with Fig and Nell.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog walking beside the stream with Fig the caterpillar and Nell the bee.

pages.text: Moss spots a shiny stone in the water.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog pausing, noticing a shiny speckled stone glinting under the stream water.

pages.text: Moss stops to look at the shiny stone.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog crouching by the water’s edge, staring at the shiny stone.

pages.text: Fig and Nell trot on without Moss.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar and Nell the bee continuing along the stream path, not noticing Moss has stopped.

pages.text: Moss looks up. Fig and Nell are gone!
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog looking up and around, the path ahead now empty of his friends.
Moss the hedgehog calling loudly along the stream, cupping his paws near his mouth.

pages.text: Nell hears the call and stops.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee pausing mid-flight, turning her head toward the sound.

pages.text: Nell and Fig trot back fast.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and Fig the caterpillar hurrying back along the stream path.

pages.text: Moss shows them the shiny stone.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog proudly holding up the shiny stone for Fig and Nell to see.

pages.text: All three grin at the shiny find.
pages.illustration: Moss, Fig and Nell gathered together by the stream, smiling at the shiny stone.
